result.summary: The page is generally well laid out, but a loading indicator appears stuck over already-rendered restaurant content in the “Popular right now” section.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner is displayed in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image even though the restaurant image, name, rating, delivery details, and surrounding content are already visible. This makes the card look unfinished and obscures the image.
issues.suggestion: Remove the loading overlay once the restaurant image/content has loaded. If only the image is loading, show a skeleton or placeholder only until the image resolves, then replace it cleanly without leaving the spinner visible.
